items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: Michael Saylor hints at first bitcoin purchase in two months as bitcoin nears $79,000
items.summary: Bitcoin rebounds from Friday’s low as Strategy’s valuation expands and bitcoin dominance climbs above 60%.

items.title: From Hawala to Swift: Inside the 1,000-year battle to move money safely
items.summary: Finance has spent centuries decoupling wealth from physical transport, but constantly erasing friction creates vectors for increasingly high-tech exploits.
